title: Instant Coffee Granola with Almonds and Apricots
changes_from_base: An agave syrup flavoured with dissolved instant coffee, vanilla and cinnamon coats the oats, almonds, pumpkin seeds and chia; the tray cools in the switched-off oven and dried apricots go in at the end.
summary: A coffee-infused granola studded with almonds and pumpkin seeds, subtly scented with cinnamon and offering the gentle warmth of dried apricots.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
dried apricots (or prunes or cherries), cut in 1 cm pieces

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Set the oven to 150 °C (130 °C fan) with the shelf in the middle and line a rimmed baking tray with baking paper.

steps.title: Brew
steps.text: Dissolve 3 tbsp instant coffee granules in 1½ tbsp hot water in a small jug.

steps.title: Whisk
steps.text: In a large bowl, whisk together 120 ml agave syrup, the brewed coffee, 1 tsp vanilla, ½ tsp ground cinnamon and ¼ tsp fine salt; then whisk in 80 ml refined coconut oil.

steps.title: Fold
steps.text: Add 260 g rolled oats, 110 g whole skin-on almonds roughly chopped, 80 g pumpkin seeds and 13 g chia seeds, folding gently until every piece is evenly coated.

steps.title: Spread
steps.text: Tip the mixture onto the lined tray and press down lightly.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Place in the oven for about 40 min, rotating at the halfway point, until golden and wonderfully fragrant (the mixture will feel soft at this stage).

steps.title: Dry
steps.text: Switch off the oven, close the door and leave the tray inside for 2 h to finish drying and crisping.

steps.title: Add
steps.text: Once cool, break into pieces and stir through 80 g dried apricots (or prunes or cherries) cut into 1 cm pieces.

tips: Stir the instant coffee into the agave syrup until it has fully dissolved before pouring, so the coffee flavour coats every oat evenly.
The mixture will feel soft when you remove it from the oven but will crisp completely as it cools
Leave it in the turned-off oven to dry fully, which prevents the edges from over-browning
Instant coffee contains caffeine, roughly 25-35 mg per 55 g serving, so this is not one for young children; stir the dried fruit in only once the granola is cold
storage: Store in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks. Contains about 25-35 mg caffeine per 55 g serving. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
